notes: This entry has 2 ubiquitin chains; chain C, the one with the most contacts to the partner, is used.

models.label: Ubiquitin in complex (PDB 1NBF)
models.note: Ubiquitin chain C of PDB 1NBF, bound to USP7. Reference frame.

models.label: Free ubiquitin (PDB 1UBQ)
models.note: X-ray structure of free ubiquitin, 1.8 Å.

models.label: ESMFold
models.note: ESMFold run on the 76-residue ubiquitin sequence.

models.label: AlphaFold 2
models.note: AlphaFold 2.3.1 (run 4525725), 5 models; showing ranked_0 = model_2_ptm (pLDDT 95.4, pTM 0.835). Other models: pLDDT 91.6-95.0, pTM 0.758-0.829.

models.label: Boltz
models.note: Boltz structure (model_0). Boltz version not recorded in the files provided; pTM not provided.

models.label: Chai-1
models.note: Chai-1 (chai_lab 0.6.1), sequence only (no MSA), run locally. Showing the sample Chai ranks highest by its own aggregate score; the five samples differ by 0.6-1.5 A Ca-RMSD from 1UBQ. Per-residue confidence is the CIF B-factor on Ca (0-100), assumed to be pLDDT (not confirmed). No PAE provided.

experimental.label: Experimental contacts (PDB 1NBF)
experimental.note: Residue pairs with any heavy atoms within 4.5 Å in the ubiquitin:USP7 crystal/NMR structure. Score = closeness (1.0 at 2.8 Å, 0 at 5.0 Å); not a probability.

mock.label: P2K-style predictions (MOCK data)
mock.note: SYNTHETIC. Generated from the experimental contacts plus noise and decoy pairs to demonstrate the interface. Not output of P2K or any predictor.

p2k.label: P2K (Waterloo)
p2k.note: Not connected. No programmatic P2K endpoint is known; this slot is where a real provider would plug in.
